web_results.name: example.com - Wikipedia
web_results.snippet: The domains *example.com*, *example.net*, *example.org* and *example.edu* are intended for general use in any kind of documentation, such as technical and software documentation, manuals, and sample software configurations. Thus, documentation writers can be sure to select a domain name without creating naming conflicts if end-users try to use the sample configurations or examples verbatim. The domains may be used in documentation without prior consultation with IANA or ICANN.
